title: Gurneys At Home: Making Face Masks
content: We're lucky to have my son Frank and his girlfriend Amelia living with us during the pandemic.They're working at home, and in their spare time they're making protective masks to donate to medical workers and people in public facing jobs.(Link to YouTube)I paint a gouache portrait of Amelia (Instagram@amelihere) at the sewing machine. The video shows the process. In the second half (around 4:00), Amelia and Frank (@frankster.g) share their tips on how to make them.
